privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introContent: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data while you use Savvy World and its services. This policy explains the types of data we collect, how we use it, and your options for managing it.
privacy.dataCollectionContent: When using any form on the site (Contact Us, Interest Registration, Newsletter Subscription):
dataCollectionList: 6. Any additional information provided by the user
privacy.dataSharingContent: We may share your data across our different departments to provide better services.
privacy.noSellingContent: We do not sell or rent your data to any third party under any circumstances.
privacy.dataRetentionContent: We retain your data only for as long as necessary to provide services or as required by law. Unnecessary data may be deleted periodically.
privacy.policyChangesContent: We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of the updated version.
yourRightsList: Request a copy of their data

contact.faqAnswer1: Savvy World is an innovative Saudi platform combining modern technologies + sustainability + digital transformation + robotics, presented to people and businesses in a simple way, aiming to bring AI and robotics into a better world — the Savvy World.
contact.faqAnswer2: It provides indoor and outdoor digital display screens operating 24/7, along with advanced immersive content using 3D and AR technologies, featuring smart targeting and precise interaction measurement.
contact.faqAnswer3: Mr.savvy is a humanoid robot introduced in Saudi Arabia as an ambassador for good technologies and sustainability. Its main idea is to simplify the world of robotics and AI for people in a fun, easy way, available in both Arabic and English.
contact.faqQuestion4: What is the role of Savvy Expo?
contact.faqAnswer4: Savvy Expo is the events and exhibitions arm of Savvy World. Its main role is to transform any event into an intelligent, engaging, and educational experience using robotics, AI, and interactive content.
contact.faqQuestion5: Do you offer green energy solutions?
contact.faqAnswer5: Yes — comprehensively and clearly. In collaboration with the Saudi Green Building Forum, we provide fully certified green solutions. We offer it as a complete 'Green Transformation Journey' for developers, companies, and banks with profitable business models.
contact.faqAnswer6: Savvy Innovation links AI, digital interaction, and green solutions to develop more sustainable urban spaces, providing solutions geared toward the future of cities and experiences.
